$comment: Relays the nightly session-e2e matrix runs against, and the interop report lists. To add yours, open a PR adding an entry. experimental: reported, but does not fail the run. knownIssues: relay-side gaps; the report labels a failed test with one when its file matches a tests entry and its error or log contains match (plain text). unsupported: features the relay does not implement; a failed test whose error or log contains match (and, when given, whose draft and file match drafts and tests) is reported as not supported instead of failed, so a cell whose only failures those are is green (but gets no full-interop medal). chromiumArgs: extra Chromium switches for this relay's runs, such as --enable-features=EnableWebTransportDraft07 for a relay that speaks an older WebTransport draft.

relays.name: openmoq (moqx)

knownIssues.summary: Its CLOSE_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION follows a STOP_SENDING on the CONNECT stream in the same packet; Chrome acts on the STOP_SENDING and reports the session lost, so the close code never arrives (moxygen).

relays.notes: As of 2026-11-11 unreachable from GitHub runners (WebTransport opening handshake fails); experimental until it is back.

relays.name: Cloudflare moq-ng
relays.notes: As of 2026-11-15 it does not offer moqt-23, so it does not run draft-23.

relays.name: laps (quicr) relay
relays.notes: libquicr relay: WebTransport path /relay (libquicr accepts only that exact path) and ALPN moqt-18.

relays.name: quichemoq
relays.notes: Added 2026-11-14 for draft-18; draft-22 since 2026-11-15, draft-18 dropped; accepts WebTransport on any path at port 443. Refuses a PUBLISH with UNINTERESTED until something subscribes, and does not support SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS.

unsupported.summary: It refuses a PUBLISH with UNINTERESTED (0x20) while nothing subscribes to the track, which draft-18 allows; tests that publish before subscribing cannot run.

relays.name: stitcher-moq (Paramount)
relays.notes: Added 2026-11-14. moq-dev moq-relay 0.17.15 in front of Paramount's MoQ sandbox. Anonymous subscribe everywhere; anonymous publish only under moq-web-e2e/** and moq-test/**. Does not offer moqt-23.

unsupported.summary: It answers PUBLISH with NOT_SUPPORTED; tests whose publisher uses PUBLISH cannot run.

relays.name: xquic
relays.notes: Added 2026-11-14. It speaks WebTransport draft-07, not the newer draft Chrome uses by default (whose SETTINGS it does not answer, so Chrome fails with ERR_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED); its runs enable Chrome's EnableWebTransportDraft07. It refuses the WebTransport handshake for moqt-18, so it runs draft-22 only.

relays.name: lminiero
relays.notes: As of 2026-11-14: refuses PUBLISH_NAMESPACE after PUBLISH of the same namespace. Fixed 2026-11-14: NAMESPACE Number of Parameters (#1858), FETCH Object ID Delta (#2006).

knownIssues.summary: It refuses a PUBLISH_NAMESPACE for a namespace the same session already sent a PUBLISH under ("Namespace already published").
